items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Then we had Dodon on banjo, Moorish Duran trumpet, and this boy by the name of George Sutton playing the drum.

ctx.x: Oh I see, so the Circle Market is pretty near.

Yeah, well the Circle was a grocery store, but it first started to crawl down. The first Seminar Market, I can remember, it wasn't named, it was called, you had the butcher stands, and you had the vegetable stand to the front part of the building, and across the street from there where you see a brick building, that used to be Maggie Gagne's hardware store. You see that brick, and when that caught a fire, years back, I forgot this was year that happened, when that caught, and during that same time the fire they…
And, yeah, yeah, and you would play just around in this little section?
